registered: before computing any event return; data: research_data/binance_pit (point-in-time USDT-M perps incl. delisted; symbols A..S only so far - an alphabetical, not performance-based, subsample); TradFi perps excluded (config/tradfi_perps.json)
events: a perp whose first hourly bar is on or after 2021-06-01 (a genuine listing); quote volume over its first 24 hours >= $10M
rule: short 0.05 (unit equity) per event from the first UTC midnight at least 24 h after the first bar; hold H days or until the data ends (delisting); total gross capped at 0.5 (all positions scaled down pro rata); hourly P&L from closes; 10 bp per side on position changes; funding at each funding time (a short receives positive funding)
pass: each added to v9.5 as its own sleeve (portfolio_v5 equal risk); strict rule; with several passes the highest 2022-26 Sharpe
reported: events per year, mean 30-day return of listed coins, sleeve by year
